text: Workshop, warehouse, water treatment and chemical rooms shall be ventilated by exhaust with make-up air from filtered louvred inlets; the chemical rooms (hypochlorite, acids, caustic, ammonia dosing) shall have dedicated exhaust of at least 10 air changes per hour with the discharge above roof level, corrosion-resistant (GRP / PP) ducts and fans, and shall be negative in pressure relative to adjacent rooms.
